questions.stem_text: Marginal cost always intersects average variable cost at

options.A: the minimum of average total cost
options.B: the point where average variable cost is equal to marginal cost
options.D: the maximum of average variable cost
options.E: the point of equilibrium between supply and demand

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - the minimum of average total cost

questions.stem_text:
Economy X is an open economy with flexible exchange rates. Economy Y is closed. Ceteris
paribus expansionary monetary policy is

options.A: more effective in X because the policy will increase net exports.
options.B: more effective in X because the policy will decrease net exports.
options.C: equally effective in X and Y.
options.D: less effective in X because the policy will decrease net exports.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: D - less effective in X because the policy will decrease net exports.
Correct option: D - saving increases by less than $X .

options.C: Shift in consumer preferences towards synthetic foods
options.D: A global decrease in the demand for agricultural products
